title: Operations on a Matrix
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N, M, Q \leq 2 \times 10^5; Every query is in one of the formats listed in the Problem Statement.; For each query in the format 1 l r x, 1 \leq l \leq r \leq M and 1 \leq x \leq 10^9.; For each query in the format 2 i x, 1 \leq i \leq N and 1 \leq x \leq 10^9.; For each query in the format 3 i j, 1 \leq i \leq N and 1 \leq j \leq M.; At least one query in the format 3 i j is given.; All values in input are integers.
